factors.title: Effective Factors (Instrument)
factors.hint: Top effective factors (Rank IC) computed live for this runner's instrument. Recent IC (last ⅓ of the sample) flipping sign or fading toward zero vs the full-sample IC = the factor is decaying. Note: this is the instrument's current factor environment, not the factors referenced inside the strategy code.

factors.empty: No factor passed the effectiveness threshold.

factors.title: Factor Library
factors.subtitle: The full system factor catalog (pandas-ta / Alpha101 / qlib …) — click a card for what each factor measures. Per-instrument timing effectiveness lives on each runner's detail page.
factors.serviceDown: Factor service unavailable — the catalog can't be loaded.
factors.catalogHint: Every factor currently available in the system, grouped by source (instrument- and market-agnostic). Click a card to see what it measures and how to read it.

detail.universe: Originally a cross-sectional factor (needs a universe); approximated here as a single-instrument time series.
detail.noDescription: No description available for this factor yet.
detail.lowConfidence: Sample too small — don't time on this reading.
detail.legend: Rank IC: rank correlation between factor values and forward returns — larger magnitude means more timing information. Recent IC: IC over the last ⅓ of the sample; flipping sign or fading toward zero means the factor is decaying. ICIR: stability of the IC. Turnover: how fast the signal flips; high turnover means high trading friction in practice.

risk.subtitle: Risk rules in force, and any locks currently blocking trades.

risk.historyEmpty: No recent risk events — no locks or rejections lately.

chat.title: Agent

divination.pageSubtitle: Hesitant on direction? Draw an omikuji — a shrine fortune slip — at the shrine of Inari, the fox deity of fortune; an I Ching or Tarot reading for a second vantage. Before you commit, the call still belongs to the data and risk engine.
divination.questionPlaceholder: Write down what you can't settle (e.g. this direction — step in or wait)…
divination.defaultQuestion: This direction I'm eyeing — step in, or wait?
divination.emptyHint: Got something unresolved on your mind? Write it down, then cast a hexagram or draw a card. The same question yields the same sign — let the thought shift, then ask again.
divination.castError: The draw failed — please try again in a moment.
divination.historyEmpty: No divinations yet. Cast one to begin.
divination.consultPrompt: I just drew 【{summary}】 at the omikuji about: "{question}". Please read it for me in my language, weaving in this sign — purely for fun, not investment advice.
divination.noChangingLines: All lines still — no changing lines
divination.disclaimer: The omikuji is a perspective, not a signal · not investment advice · the trade still answers to data and risk

evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.subtitle: Agents explore improvements from events and simulation feedback, validate them through backtests and observation, and leave adoption to you.
evolution.empty: No evolution runs yet. Trigger one via the chat agent: "run evolution" or "evolve sma_cross".
evolution.truncated: Showing the latest {n} — earlier ones aren't listed here.

detail.title: Evolution Run
detail.retryHint: Preserve the original seed, window and parameters; prepare and approve costs again
detail.retryPrompt: Retry evolution run {runId} after repair. Retrieve its original retry plan, preserve source, evaluation window, parameters and candidate count, run preparation and request fresh cost approval. Do not change the evaluation window or adopt automatically.
detail.abortDescription: The current stage will be cancelled and no further slots will run. LLM costs already incurred cannot be reversed.
detail.noCandidates: No slots have been created yet.

start.label: Start evolution
start.hint: Start an automatic evolution loop from the strategy or paper run on this page

loop.costUnavailable: Cost ledger unavailable; this does not mean zero spend.
loop.costExplanation: Reservations cover in-flight or unconfirmed calls and are not settled spend.
loop.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the last received state; please retry.
loop.safety: Research continues independently of chat. No automatic adoption, Runner launch, or orders.

guidance.target_resolved: Preparing frozen data and the E1 baseline. No repeat trigger is needed.
guidance.baseline_ready: The baseline is ready. The scheduler will hand off to E2 automatically.
guidance.campaign_running: Evaluating five generations. Insufficient evidence ends the campaign without forcing a winner.
guidance.candidate_locked: One candidate has been selected and fixed. Independent paper observation is being prepared.
guidance.waiting_forward: Waiting for real Forward evidence: at least 30 days and 3 independent events, up to 90 days.
guidance.holdout_running: Testing the fixed candidate on data reserved from selection. The test is single-use; another candidate cannot be substituted for a retry.
guidance.adoption_ready: Validation stages have passed. Review the evidence before manually adopting into Strategy Lab; adoption remains research-only.
guidance.rejected: Validation did not pass. No automatic adoption; review diagnostics and Campaign evidence.
guidance.insufficient_evidence: This research has insufficient evidence for adopting an improvement. Review hypotheses, statistical checks, and event coverage before deciding whether to add data or revise hypotheses.
guidance.failed: Execution encountered a fault, so strategy effectiveness is not established. Review diagnostics; refreshing does not restart or repurchase the experiment.
guidance.holdout_ready: Observation passed. Awaiting the single-use reserved-data test.
guidance.aborted: Research was aborted. Incurred model costs remain payable; strategy effectiveness is not established.

loop.title: Automatic Evolution Loops
loop.empty: No evolution loop yet. Say “start evolution” from a strategy, paper run, or E1 result.

campaign.title: Historical event research
campaign.empty: No event campaign yet; E1 single-generation runs keep their existing semantics.
campaign.detailSubtitle: The audit trail for frozen facts, hypothesis lineage, selection, ablations, Forward, and one-shot holdout.
campaign.adoptHint: Adoption does not promote, start Runner, or trade; runner_eligible is enforced false.

workflow.partial: Some data is loading or unavailable. The tasks and counts below cover only the sources loaded so far.
workflow.scope: Counts cover loaded workflows only. Settled costs are shown per task.
workflow.historyHint: These records are not linked to the currently loaded workflows. Original experiment and audit views remain available.
workflow.targetUnavailable: Original target information is unavailable. Existing research remains readable.
workflow.auditHint: Record IDs locate experiments. Hashes check that data, code, or configuration match; they do not measure strategy quality.
workflow.forwardHint: One selected candidate is observed independently for at least 30 days and 3 independent events, up to 90 days. Reserved data is tested only after observation passes.
workflow.hypothesisHint: Agents propose hypotheses and test different response styles. A successful evaluation does not establish an effective strategy.
workflow.fdrHint: Statistical checks control chance findings from searching many candidates. Passing still requires Forward observation and reserved-data validation.
workflow.dataExplanation: Research data is fixed at the start and shared by all candidates. IDs and versions are available below for verification.
workflow.roundNotLoaded: This round is not in the loaded records yet. Load more evaluation results.
workflow.roundEmpty: No evaluation results are available for this round.

comparison.title: Did this evolution improve the strategy?
comparison.unavailable: A complete evaluation report is unavailable.
comparison.scopeMismatch: Different evaluation window or execution basis; reference only, not evidence of improvement.
comparison.evidenceBoundary: Completion, passing evaluation and improvement are separate conclusions. This E1 historical experiment does not establish adoption readiness.
comparison.scope: Full evaluation window: {start} → {end} · {bars} bars · Fee per fill {fee}
comparison.selectionHint: The best candidate is ranked by this run’s fitness. These are full historical-window results, not independent Forward or one-time holdout evidence. Review validation, trade samples and overfitting risk.

verdict.noPassedCandidate: Run completed; no candidate passed evaluation
verdict.comparisonUnavailable: A candidate passed; improvement remains unconfirmed
verdict.improved: Best candidate fitness exceeds the original
verdict.notImproved: Candidate passed; fitness did not exceed the original

comparison.validationUnavailable: No temporal consistency check is available. Stability across segments is unconfirmed.

costs.chatUnlinked: No trusted turn association is available. This does not mean chat was free.
costs.chatShared: This turn is linked to multiple approvals. Its shared cost must not be summed per task.
costs.chatReceipt: Model calls in this turn: {calls} · known estimate {known} · calls with unknown cost: {unknown}
costs.title: Model costs and usage receipts · USD
costs.receiptHint: The subtotal and recorded amount are overlapping views, not separate charges. Unconfirmed calls may have been billed. Legacy amounts remain, but do not establish a complete bill. Costs are estimated from returned token usage and frozen rates; provider records determine the final bill.
costs.failed: Failed / rejected candidates include confirmed cost {known} and {unknown} unconfirmed calls. These amounts are included above; do not add them again.
costs.chatScope: Only the turn that created this approval is included, excluding conversation history, diagnostics and later chat. Frozen-rate estimates are not reconciled provider invoices.

dataHealth.title: Event Data Health
dataHealth.subtitle: Coverage, first acceptance, revisions, and snapshot integrity for the event source of truth.
dataHealth.empty: No event source has been archived yet.

walletAccounting.legacyWarning: Trades and balances retained; legacy positions are no longer managed automatically. This is not verified new-run performance.
walletAccounting.stopWarning: Stopping does not close positions or return capital. Release requires a flat book.
